payload.blocks: Rule 6 of your release order (never more than two full suites at once). Other parts of the chain go on without it.
payload.headline: Cap of two full test suites at once: lower maxLeads to 2, or add a suite lane?

parts.cause: Checked config and supervision spec: supervisor.maxLeads is 4 (core/config-standard/supervisor.yaml) and lanes (fgos slots) count workers, not suites. Each lead runs the full suite at land time.

options.does: At most two leads run, so at most two land-time suites.
options.gain: No code; one config line; works today.
options.harm: Also caps plans that would not run a suite at that moment; slower throughput.
options.label: Set maxLeads to 2 in project config

options.cost: Est. 100-200 lines in holder-lock registry and land gate; its own plan.
options.does: A full test run takes one of two machine-wide suite locks; others wait.
options.gain: Caps exactly what you asked; leads stay at 4.
options.label: Add a 'suite' lane lock

options.does: No enforcement; the supervisor counts by hand.
options.harm: Lost on rotation, the same failure this discussion fixes.
options.label: Leave it to the supervisor's judgment

parts.recommendation: Set maxLeads to 2 now; open the suite lane as its own backlog item only if throughput hurts.

scope.allows: The discussion records maxLeads=2 as the cap; the planner writes the config change.
scope.forbids: Adding a new lock in this discussion.

parts.what: Your order says never more than two full test suites run at once. Nothing enforces that today.
